content: Do I need to lift heavy to build muscle?

Not exclusively, but load matters. Building muscle (hypertrophy) requires progressive overload - gradually increasing the challenge to your muscles over time. That can mean heavier weight, more reps, more sets, or better form and control.

The sweet spot is usually 6-12 reps per set at a weight that feels challenging by the last rep. You can absolutely build muscle at lighter loads if you push close to failure and accumulate volume, but going too light means you'd need way more reps and sets to get the same stimulus - less efficient.

For your 100kg bench goal in three months, you'll need progressive loading on heavier weights. Light stuff alone won't cut it. 💪
